_comment: The subject catalogue, so contributors pick a subject instead of typing one.
Keys are collection keys — '<year>/<branch>', or '<year>/common' for a year
that is not split by branch. Values are the subjects taught in that
collection. `name` is required; `code` is strongly encouraged, because the
code is what groups every paper for a subject together on the site.
These lists have to come from the actual MUJ curriculum. Inventing subject
codes would be worse than having none: a wrong code silently files a paper
under a subject that does not exist, and nobody notices until someone goes
looking for it. So this ships with only what could be verified.
## It fills itself in as the archive grows
The picker offers the union of this file and every subject already present
in that collection's papers, so a subject only has to be typed once ever.
Adding it here just means the first contributor does not have to type it.
The scheme-and-syllabus PDF for each programme lists every subject with its
code, per semester. Copy them in, run `node build.js`, and commit. CI checks
the shape and that every key is a collection the catalogue defines.
